NONE: › mainly UK formal written abbreviation for Esquire: a title added after a man's name on envelopes and official documents. If Esq. is used, Mr is not used before the name.
…先生（Esquir的縮寫，加在男性姓名後的尊稱，用於信封上或官方文件中。如果用了 Esq，姓名前就不再用 Mr. ）
› US written abbreviation usually used only after the full name of a man or woman who is a lawyer

example: Address it to my lawyer, Steven A. Neil, Esq./Gloria Neil, Esq.
把信寄給我的律師：史蒂芬‧A‧尼爾律師／格洛麗亞‧尼爾律師。
